inputs.command:
set -u; printf '%s
' SCHEMA_AUDIT_START; date -u +%FT%TZ; hostname; id -u; printf '%s
' --DEPLOYED--; cat /opt/madworld/.github-deployed-sha 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' --ABUSE_TABLES--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-madworld}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB:-madworld}" -Atc "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename LIKE 'abuse_control_%' ORDER BY tablename;" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' --SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-madworld}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB:-madworld}" -Atc "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='schema_migrations';" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' --MIGRATION_COUNT--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-madworld}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB:-madworld}" -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM schema_migrations;" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' SCHEMA_AUDIT_DONE
